question: What is the meaning of materials in relation to product information?
description: Materials are the processed raw materials used for the manufacture of construction products. They are an essential part of product information, as they determine the composition and properties of the product. The percentage of raw material the object consists of is also a key piece of information. This data is crucial for understanding the environmental impact and sustainability of the product.
